name: e-rechnung-pruefer-test-tools
description: Test tools of the E-Rechnung Prüfer, not part of the program and never shipped: Playwright (browsers of the end-to-end tests), pdf.js (an independent PDF reader as test oracle) and esbuild (reproduction of the engine bundle). Installed by the workflows (npm ci --ignore-scripts with package-lock.json); the program itself has no npm dependencies.
